name: Imai Kanae
source:
A loose widow. The woman who ran over the protagonist with her bicycle.

She lost her husband in a tragic accident six years ago and has been alone ever since. Lately, she has been feeling lonely...

[From [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=283825]getchu[/url]]
